title: The Goa Human Resource Development Act, 2012.
full_text: The Goa Human Resource Development Act, 2012. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201212 Act Number: 12 Enactment Date: 2012-08-06 Act Year: 2012 Short Title: The Goa Human Resource Development Act, 2012. Long Title: To make special provision for developing human resources in the State of Goa by imparting required training to the unemployed persons and to the work force in the State of Goa, so as to make available the trained and skilled personnel to the Government Departments, Institutions, Government Undertakings, autonomous bodies, social institutions, Business establishments, individuals, etc., and also with a view to assist the unemployed youth to get gainful employment and for that purpose to establish a Human Resource Development Corporation, and to provide for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
